statements.text: Well, I think it's more of an opportunity than a threat, but I think our biggest risk is the lack of equity in how technology is acquired, the unevenness at which schools will be able to implement or integrate newer technologies into the curriculum. [...] And I do see a greater role that AI will promote in terms of individualized instruction, which could be helpful, especially in the early grades in terms of, you know, reading, reading acquisition.
Congress needs access to unbiased technological expertise to weigh the pros and cons of policy questions surrounding cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, quantum computing and so many more matters

statements.text: The American public has felt the consequences as Congress's slow action on technology regulation including on data privacy and cryptocurrency. Now, generative artificial intelligence has emerged with the potential to significantly change the way we work and live.
statements.venue: Press release on the OTA Improvement and Enhancement Act

statements.text:
I agree @BarackObama -- the time for a shortened workweek is NOW!

All workers should feel the benefits of increased productivity that automation and AI are bringing, and I've introduced a bill to do just that. https://t.co/iLoEVCprpC
statements.quoted: BREAKING: Former President @BarackObama joins the call for shorter work weeks! "With automation...we need to consider bigger changes, and we should start talking about that now: things like a shorter work week!" https://t.co/FMTERQzhvA

statements.text: 5/5 We must prepare as a nation for what AI will bring. My Thirty-Two Hour Workweek Act is a critical piece of this conversation. Read more about my bill: https://t.co/WlPMdSKqWb

1/5 A recent report shows changes could affect the American workforce due to the large scale deployment of AI and automation. My Thirty-Two Hour Workweek Act would ensure gains in efficiency  are felt equitably by workers who may be left out by these developments. 🧵 https://t.co/8TnfttxZXS
With developments in AI, we must ensure this tech complements human work. We must consider my 32-Hour Workweek Act.

Innovative tech like AI will require us to reimagine the workweek and our relationship with work. It was my pleasure to give opening remarks this morning to highlight the need for legislation like my Thrity-Two Hour Workweek Act. https://t.co/JizY4q94a0

statements.text: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 3854, the Modernizing All Veterans and Survivors Claims Processing Act, as amended. [...] As the world around us continues to advance in this way, we cannot handcuff the Department of Veterans Affairs and bar them from utilizing this remarkable technology, but neither can we let them proceed unfettered without considering all the implications of its use. [...] AI is no substitute for a well-trained workforce, especially one that is as mission-driven and dedicated as the one we have at the VA.
statements.context: Floor speech in the House of Representatives supporting H.R. 3854, the Modernizing All Veterans and Survivors Claims Processing Act.
